T: Comic book love, diner booth dinner.
D: A New Jersey comic book artist falls for a woman who doesn't fit the picture he's drawn of her.
P: Serve the mains when Holden and Banky argue it out in the diner booth.
S: the late-night diner booth in Red Bank
Thick-cut chips fried crisp, smothered in hot brown gravy and melted mozzarella, the New Jersey diner way, eaten with a fork.
Jersey ham, egg and cheese sliders
a Jersey breakfast between comic deadlines

Thick-cut smoked ham fried until the edges curl, stacked with a soft fried egg and melted American cheese in buttered slider buns with ketchup. Cut 400g thick smoked ham into 8 slices about 5mm thick and nick the edges so they don't buckle. Fry in a buttered pan over medium heat 2 minutes a side until caramelised at the edges. Fry 8 small eggs until the whites set and yolks are jammy, adding a slice of American cheese to each for the last minute under a lid. Toast 8 buttered slider buns and stack ham, egg and cheese with a squeeze of ketchup.
Bluntman and Chronic on the convention floor
Toasted bagel halves spread with pizza sauce, topped with mozzarella and pepperoni and grilled until bubbling and golden.
M: a New Jersey classic for two comic artists
Franks fried in oil, stuffed into half a round of pizza bread with fried potatoes, peppers and onions, mustard on top.
the diner booth where the friendship gets tested

Thin beef patties with slow-cooked caramelised onions and Swiss cheese, pressed between buttered rye and griddled until crisp and oozing, pickles alongside. Slowly cook 3 sliced onions in 30g butter with a pinch of salt over low heat for 30 minutes until jammy. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin oval patties and season. Sear in a hot pan 2 minutes a side. Butter 8 slices of rye on one side. On the unbuttered sides layer Swiss cheese (8 slices), a patty, onions and more cheese. Cook in a pan over medium heat, pressing, 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Halve and serve with pickles.
W: the dessert case by the register
Short-grain rice simmered slowly in milk with sugar and vanilla until thick, chilled and dusted with cinnamon.
K: the late-night diner booth in Red Bank

Ice cold root beer poured over big scoops of vanilla ice cream in frosted diner glasses until the foam spills over, whipped cream and a cherry on top. Put 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Drop 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream (about 400g total) into each glass. Tilt the glass and pour 250ml cold root beer slowly down the side so the foam rises without spilling, then top up once it settles. Finish with a swirl of whipped cream from 100ml cream and a maraschino cherry. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.

s.note: the late-night diner booth in Red Bank
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, soak 30 minutes and dry. Fry at 150C for 6 minutes, then at 190C for 3 minutes until crisp. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 400ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Pile the chips on a tray, pour over the gravy and cover with 150g grated mozzarella, then grill until melted.

s.note: Bluntman and Chronic on the convention floor
s.how: Split 4 bagels and toast lightly. Spread each half with 1 tbsp pizza sauce, top with 150g grated mozzarella and 60g sliced pepperoni, and grill for 4 minutes until bubbling. Cut into halves to share.

m.note: a New Jersey classic for two comic artists
m.how: Fry 600g diced potatoes in oil until golden, then add 2 sliced green capsicums and 2 sliced onions and cook 10 minutes more until soft. Fry 8 hot dog franks until blistered. Split 4 pizza bread rounds, fill each with 2 franks and a big scoop of the potato and pepper mix, and finish with mustard.

w.note: the dessert case by the register
w.how: Simmer 150g arborio rice in 1L milk with 80g caster sugar over low heat for 35 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Stir in 1 tsp vanilla, pour into 4 glasses and chill for 2 hours. Dust with cinnamon before serving.
